title: Happy with my new memory foam mattress.
text: Happy with my new memory foam mattress.. Aside from delivery delays, which Amazon gracefully gave me a courtesy partial refund, my mattress finally arrived.  I let it air out and sit for 24 hours until it expanded to 9 to 9.5 inches.  It hasn't expanded to 10" yet but wow what a delightful sleeping experience.  It's only been 1 night so I'll be back in a few weeks to update my review.  So far I'm extremely pleased with my purchase and Amazon customer service's help in tracking down my lost package.

product_metadata.title: Perfect Cloud Made in The USA UltraPlush Charcoal-Infused 10-inch Memory Foam Mattress - Pressure Relieving - Bed-in-a-Box (Queen)
features: DESIGN | 2-inch cooling gel-infused foam. 1.5-inch air-infused foam. 6.5-inch charcoal-infused base layer of support foam reduces odors and maximizes comfort.
Better Sleep | Multi-layered memory foam helps relieve tension from common head, neck, and shoulder pain. The cooling gel helps you fall asleep and stay comfortable throughout the night.
Weightless Sleep | Temperature-regulated construction contours to your body shape and unique sleeping style. The motion isolation helps you stay asleep even with partners.
Shipped to Your Door | Compressed, vacuum sealed, and shipped right to your front door for easy transport to any room. Simply unbox, unroll, and your mattress will immediately begin to expand.
10-Year Warranty | This mattress is PUR-Foam-certified, and backed by a 10-year warranty. 30-day sleep trial. Made in the USA. Dimensions: 80 x 60 x 10 inches.
